episodes.title: First Son of Texas
episodes.summary: "First Son of Texas" Eli McCullough must survive a frontier Comanche attack in 1849 and lead his family's empire through difficult times in 1915.

episodes.title: The Plum Tree
episodes.summary: Young Eli must learn how to live among the Comanches in 1849. In 1915, Eli and Pete clash over how to respond to an unexpected attack on their home.

episodes.title: Second Empire
episodes.summary: Young Eli trains as a warrior, but makes enemies in 1849. In 1915, Eli and Phineas struggle to help the family in Austin while Pete faces his demons.

episodes.title: Death Song
episodes.summary: Young Eli faces a test of survival; the McCulloughs enact a dangerous plan to take the fight to their enemy.

episodes.title: No Prisoners
episodes.summary: An enemy forces Young Eli to question his loyalties in 1849. In 1915, the McCulloughs' past comes back to haunt them with deadly results.

episodes.title: The Buffalo Hunter
episodes.summary: Young Eli makes a choice with dangerous consequences; the McCulloughs deal with a tragedy; Jeannie wants to save the family.

episodes.title: Marriage Bond
episodes.summary: Young Eli must navigate tribal politics; a crisis forces Pete and Sally into a decision that will change the family.

episodes.title: Honey Hunt
episodes.summary: Prairie Flower is torn between love and duty; Pete grows closer to Maria; Eli brings Phineas in on a dangerous secret.

episodes.title: The Prophecy
episodes.summary: Young Eli must trust a strange ally to survive; Eli's past guides him to a choice that puts him and Phineas at odds.

episodes.title: Scalps
episodes.summary: The tribe faces an unexpected return; Eli's plan for the future forces Pete into a life-or-death decision about his loyalties.

episodes.title: Numunuu
episodes.summary: Young Eli leads a daring Comanche raid into Mexico in 1852; in 1915, the McCullough family confronts a threat to their growing oil business.

episodes.title: Ten Dollars and a Plucked Goose
episodes.summary: After a devastating attack, Young Eli must help the Comanches regroup in 1852. In 1915, Pete's return causes fractures in the McCullough family.

episodes.title: The Blind Tiger
episodes.summary: Young Eli's Comanches must survive a dangerous journey in 1852; in 1915, Eli and Pete are forced to work together to deal with a new enemy.

episodes.title: Scalped a Dog
episodes.summary: A new danger reveals old wounds in Young Eli's tribe in 1852. In 1916, Eli and Phineas try to fight off Standard Oil as Maria Garcia returns.

episodes.title: Hot Oil
episodes.summary: Young Eli is forced hide a deadly secret in 1852. In 1916, Maria's return brings devastating consequences for the McCullough's oil business.

episodes.title: The Blue Light
episodes.summary: Young Eli must protect Ingrid in 1852. In 1916, a new attack from Standard Oil forces the McCullough family to come together.

episodes.title: Somebody Get a Shovel
episodes.summary: The Comanches go to war in 1852. In 1916, the McCulloughs' fight with Standard Oil reaches a breaking point. Eli takes a scalp.

episodes.title: All Their Guilty Stains
episodes.summary: Young Eli's Comanche band are forced to survive on their own in 1852. In 1916, the McCulloughs search for Maria while Jeannie discovers a devastating secret.

episodes.title: The Bear
episodes.summary: Young Eli's tribe encounters soldiers that make an unexpected offer in 1852. In 1916, Pete makes a decision that could tear the family apart.

episodes.title: Legend
episodes.summary: Young Eli is forced into a life-changing decision in 1852. In 1916, Eli wages a final war with Standard Oil, forcing a confrontation with Pete.
